notes.raw:
\*Data extrapolated 300-1300 K. Phase changes: 1128 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Nd; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.724$ kcal/mol. 1289 K, melting point of Nd; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.707$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 12.585 + 0.800 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.795 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 12.585 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.400 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.795 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 4.054$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1128 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -127.833 + 4.445 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 2.725 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 117.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -127.833 - 4.445 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 2.725 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 58.875 \text{T}^{-1} + 52.515 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1128-1289 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -124.719 - 2.244 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 45.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -124.719 + 2.244 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 22.675 \text{T}^{-1} + 6.108 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1289-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -126.604 - 2.106 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 45.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -126.604 + 2.106 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.240 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 22.675 \text{T}^{-1} + 8.559 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Semenkovich (105). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from Vasilev (123). High-temperature data based on Fesenko (38). Data extrapolated from 300 to 1300 K.
